title: Nummat axaxime sinni seeco abe
intro: farmoyti dubuk soolah gibdi ummattah fanat, ken seecak inki numma rabbih fanah oson dirab sanamittet xakabuh raaqan wak. Tama nabiyyi kaxxa maqna leh yan migaq le—‘kalalu faxa num’—takkay immay dubuh qanxaffe kee qanxaffe le. Sahlin geysis kee maqar le maabitinah, ta rooci baad isih ellecaboh diggoowele qibaadah farmo quuka. Islaaminna kitaabih addal kaxxaam dumaahi xaagitte awlissah tan tama steadfast figure baxxaaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Yi ummatta mango rabbitte tabbixe, anu qaran kee ardi gine numuh taamitoonuh ken seece.
Anu inni agattiinah foocal sooleh, anu keenik faxe acwa faxam warse—yi fayxi dubuh ken miraacisak sugte.
Kaxxa silayti yi ummattal qibaadah digaalah ruube, silaytiy Qur'aanak mango kee say numih gurral edde yaaba.
Inki inki nabiyyih inna hinnay, anu inni xaagih addal kaxxaam edde yaabe barra kee xaylo yoh maaca, inni farmo dubuk inni ummattah seecaanam kinniimih taagah.
Yi migaq adda xer maqna le- inki num faxah yan kalalu kee dacayroh mablat axawah tan.
Yi ummatta elle sugteh tan golol baxsale jograafih qangarat tamixxigeeh, ken baaxoh addal coox daabisiyyih taagah baxsale qaybih addat baxxaqimteh sugte.

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning. (54:18)
